label: TP
reason: Alert 2 (java/sql-injection) is a confirmed TP: user input from HTTP headers flows through param->bar->sql and reaches batchUpdate() at line 58 without parameterization, creating a direct SQL injection vector. Alert 1 (java/xss) is likely FP/mitigated because encodeForHTML() is applied to the sql string before HTML output at lines 61-64, though the benchmark may intend this as a detectable pattern.

evidence.note: SQL injection sink: batchUpdate(sql) receives unsanitized user input via bar
